name: command
title: Command Menu
description: A searchable command palette — filtered, grouped items with keyboard navigation, optionally inside a ⌘K dialog.

meta.whenToUse: A keyboard-first command palette or fuzzy-search picker — global ⌘K, action launchers, searchable lists.
meta.whenNotToUse: A simple form select (Select), a small static action menu (DropdownMenu).
